stories.title: El adelanto electoral no frena las movilizaciones: miles de personas llaman en Barcelona a la huelga general por la vivienda

en.title: Early elections fail to stop mobilizations: thousands in Barcelona call for general strike over housing
en.summary: A large housing protest march in Barcelona exceeded organizer expectations and required route changes. Clashes with police and property damage occurred at the march's end.

stories.title: Aznar: "Si Pedro Sánchez puede formar gobierno tras las elecciones del 29 de noviembre, la Monarquía se terminaría"

en.title: Aznar: "If Pedro Sánchez can form government after November 29 elections, the Monarchy would end"
en.summary: Former Prime Minister Aznar criticizes a law granting voting rights to descendants of Spanish exiles, claiming it aims to alter voter rolls for political advantage.

stories.title: UGT y CC.OO. caldearán la calle con una huelga general este otoño por la vivienda

en.title: UGT and CC.OO. will heat up the streets with a general strike this autumn over housing
en.summary: Major Spanish unions plan a 24-hour strike for autumn demanding affordable housing and wages while protesting failed wage negotiations with employers.

stories.title: Medvedev, expulsado del torneo de Pekín por un pelotazo a un espectador

en.title: Medvedev expelled from Beijing tournament for hitting ball at spectator
en.summary: Tennis player Daniil Medvedev was immediately disqualified from the Beijing ATP 500 tournament after hitting a ball that struck a spectator in the head during his match against Novak Djokovic.

stories.title: Miles de personas llaman a la huelga general por la vivienda en Barcelona: “Esto acaba de empezar”

en.title: Thousands call for general strike over housing in Barcelona: "This is just beginning"
en.summary: The Barcelona tenants union calls to paralyze the country and will coordinate with major unions to set a date for the general strike.

stories.title: Los sindicatos UGT y CC OO irán a la huelga general por la crisis de la vivienda

en.title: Unions UGT and CC OO will strike over housing crisis
en.summary: Major Spanish unions UGT and CC OO have called a general strike to address the housing crisis, responding to demands from tenant organizations and mass protests. The strike is scheduled shortly before general elections.

stories.title: CCOO y UGT ceden a la presión y pactan convocar una huelga general por la crisis de vivienda

en.title: CCOO and UGT yield to pressure and agree to call a general strike over housing crisis
en.summary: CCOO and UGT unions have agreed to organize a general strike regarding the housing crisis following pressure from tenant organizations. No specific date for the strike has been announced.

stories.title: Los jesuitas expulsan al sacerdote Francesc Peris por abusos sexuales a menores

en.title: Jesuits expel priest Francesc Peris for sexual abuse of minors
en.summary: The Jesuit order has expelled a priest after a canonical process found him guilty of crimes against minors spanning over 50 years.

stories.title: Medvedev, descalificado en semifinales del Abierto de China tras dar un pelotazo a un espectador

en.title: Medvedev disqualified in Chinese Open semifinals after hitting spectator with ball
en.summary: Russian player Medvedev, ranked fifth in the world, was disqualified from the Chinese Open semifinals after striking a spectator with a ball. The incident occurred while he was losing the match.

stories.title: Medvedev es descalificado por dar un pelotazo fortuito a un aficionado en el torneo de Pekín

en.title: Medvedev disqualified for hitting spectator with accidental ball shot at Beijing tournament
en.summary: Medvedev was disqualified after unintentionally striking a spectator with a ball during his Beijing tournament match. Djokovic advanced to the final against De Miñaur after the disqualification.

stories.title: Sánchez adelanta las elecciones al 29 de noviembre: “Necesitamos una mayoría progresista mucho más amplia”

en.title: Sánchez advances elections to November 29: "We need a much broader progressive majority"
en.summary: President Sánchez has moved forward the general elections to November 29, citing the need for a broader progressive majority. He reviewed achievements of the left-wing coalition government.

stories.title: Pedro Sánchez adelanta las elecciones generales al 29 de noviembre

en.title: Pedro Sánchez advances general elections to November 29
en.summary: President Sánchez has ended the parliamentary term and called early elections for November 29 following the defeat of housing decrees and large-scale mobilizations.

stories.title: Vodafone reduce a 166 los afectados por el ERE de su filial VOIS en España

en.title: Vodafone reduces to 166 those affected by ERE of its VOIS subsidiary in Spain
en.summary: Vodafone has reduced the number of employees affected by a restructuring plan at its VOIS subsidiary to 166 people. Compensation will be calculated at 45 days per year of service for employment periods prior to the February 2012 labor reform.

stories.title: La abogacía pide reforzar la seguridad jurídica y la calidad regulatoria

en.title: The legal profession calls for strengthening legal certainty and regulatory quality
en.summary: Spain's legal profession has identified frequent regulatory changes and increasing regulatory complexity as major concerns for businesses, calling for improved legal certainty and regulatory quality.

stories.title: Aznar cree que la monarquía estará en peligro si Sánchez vuelve a gobernar

en.title: Aznar believes the monarchy will be in danger if Sánchez returns to govern
en.summary: Former Spanish President José María Aznar has stated that the November 29 general elections are the most important since the transition to democracy and warned that another government under Pedro Sánchez would endanger the Constitution, Spanish unity, and the constitutional monarchy.

stories.title: Airtificial gana un contrato para automatizar fábricas de Tesla en India

en.title: Airtificial wins contract to automate Tesla factories in India
en.summary: Airtificial has secured a contract to provide automation services for Tesla manufacturing facilities in India.

stories.title: UGT y CCOO pactan convocar una huelga general por la crisis de la vivienda

en.title: UGT and CCOO agree to call a general strike over the housing crisis
en.summary: Trade unions UGT and CCOO have agreed to organize a general strike during autumn in response to the country's housing crisis.
